Unity Software Inc.'s platform is used by creators of all types - such as developers, artists, and designers - to build content in gaming and non-gaming industries, including automotive, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector, robotics, architecture, civil and mechanical engineering, design and construction.

businessActivities: Xpeng Inc. is a Chinese Smart EV and NEV company that designs, develops, manufactures, and markets Smart EVs and NEVs that primarily appeal to the large and growing base of middle-class consumers in China.
Xpeng Inc. develops full stack advanced driver assistance systems, or ADAS, software in house and has deployed such software on mass-produced vehicles.
Xpeng Inc.'s products include Smart EVs, NEVs and advanced ADAS software system.
